speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: As a matter of policy, Singapore will continue to partner like-minded countries to pursue peace and stability for our region.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: We seek to be friends with all militaries and encourage them to use our port and airbases for transit.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Indeed, military ships and submarines from many countries, both from ASEAN-Plus countries like US, China, India and Japan, as well as from other continents like Europe, South America, Oceania and Africa, stop and use facilities at Changi Naval Base.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: The rationale for my question is this: I am essentially asking with respect to our plans if (a) the US' alliances with its existing allies will weaken or be less involved, or (b) if the US becomes even more active or more involved.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: I am seeking to understand the Government's forward-planning in these respects.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: I feel that it is important that Singaporeans know the Government's plans to deal with the different scenarios.

speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
text: Our policy must work to the best interest of Singapore and Singaporeans.

speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
text: Page: 7 Now, obviously, we have to watch what other countries do with foreign policy.

speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
text: Singapore is a small country and, as I have said in my answer, we will work with like-minded partners who pursue peace and stability in our region.

speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
text: In this framework, we have facilitated and pushed for ADMM-Plus.

speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
text: We push for joint cooperation and exercises with other countries and we want to seek to have as many friends as possible.

speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
text: We encourage countries to use our facilities, whether it is Changi Naval Base or the airbases.

speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
text: There are specific agreements that we have entered into.

speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
text: To answer the many theoretical scenarios which the Member has raised, which I do not propose to address, I think our starting point is whatever the calculations of other countries, whatever their foreign policy, we start from this important fundamental – we seek to make sure that Singapore benefits the most.

speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
text: Our foreign policy or defence policy is predicated on making sure that we position ourselves in the best possible position to survive and to compete.

speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
text: We want to make friends with as many militaries and countries as possible.
